newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Quiet Russian MinFins firm on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Quiet Russian MinFins firm on foreign buying.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed in calm trading on Tuesday and dealers said buying interest was seen mainly from abroad in the third and fourth tranches.
"Fluctuations have been within a spread (0.25-0.30 point). It looks like everybody took profits and is doing nothing ahead of the (New Year) holidays," one dealer said.

But an International Moscow Bank dealer said foreign operators were seen buying the third, fourth tranches. They were buying the fifth tranche as well but some Moscow operators were resisting the rise, he added.
Dealers said the most actively traded third, fourth and fifth tranches met resistance at 83.90, 60.90 and 42.50 respectively.
